title: The Corrupted Crater
description: Travel to the corrupted crater and find the chest hidden at its heart. Only the first wanderer to reach it will claim what lies inside.
lore: I have watched that hollow breathe for longer than I care to count. The land never forgave whatever opened it. Stand there first, and the chest is yours. Come late, and you will find only the wound it left.

objectives.description: Reach the chest in the corrupted crater

onComplete.command: execute if score crater_chest cm_crater matches 0 run give {player} coinsje:copper_coin 5
execute if score crater_chest cm_crater matches 0 run title {player} actionbar {"text":"You reached the crater first. Its coin is yours.","color":"gold"}
